en: The Tyrant is dead. It will not build another hive, just yet.

en: Below, the Tyrant beast lies dead.

en: Tyranids accumulate Biomass as they fight and consume their enemies. The amount of available Biomass is indicated by the Biomass meter. Biomass will give you access to the Tyranids' global abilities.
zh_new: 泰倫蟲族會在戰鬥並吞噬敵人時累積生體物質。可用生體物質會顯示在生體物質計量表上。生體物質可用於泰倫蟲族的全局能力。

en: You have built a Tyranid synapse creature. Hormagaunt and Termagant squads will become more powerful under the influence of synapse creatures. Be sure to protect your synapse creatures when combating the enemy.
zh_new: 你已經生成了一頭泰倫蟲族突觸生物。賀瑪根和特瑪根小隊會在突觸生物影響下變得更強。與敵人交戰時，務必保護你的突觸生物。
notes: 2026-05-17 12:20 JST main chat Tyranid objective cleanup

en: Scans indicate the presence of hive nodes -- Tyranid biological turrets.
zh_new: 掃描顯示附近存在蟲巢節點，也就是泰倫蟲族生物炮塔。

en: Kill off the Hive Tyrant Alpha to disrupt the Tyranids in the area.
zh_new: 殺死阿爾法蟲巢暴君，以擾亂此區域內的泰倫蟲族。
